title: Make source-stderr transport fixture child mode require an explicit parent marker
outcome: The transport fixture cannot exit the normal libtest process successfully merely because an ambient source-stderr-fixture.bin file is present in its current directory.
acceptance: Child mode requires an explicit parent-controlled marker or nonce in addition to its fixture data, and an ambient fixture file alone cannot cause process::exit(0) in the normal harness.

Observable regression coverage distinguishes normal harness execution with an ambient fixture file from intended child execution, while the real bounded-read stderr acceptance and refusal tests remain effective.
